capabilities: Render nodeBook code fences as draggable, interactive concept maps
Show inferred relations with proof tooltips
Switch between morphs and a containment (Nest) view
Simulate Petri-net process notation by clicking to fire tokens
Extend the type system via a schema store note, inline schema fences, or per-graph schema links
extras: The README only covers manual installation; the full CNL language reference and a 17-lesson tutorial live outside the README, and schema syntax is only summarized there. Schemas support is seeded as an editable nodebook/schemas.md note on first run.
intentEvidence: the Obsidian twin of logseq-nodebook, built on the same @nodebook/dom renderer
problem: Obsidian has no way to turn controlled-natural-language text in a note into an interactive, typed concept map with inference and process simulation.

relations.evidence: the Obsidian twin of logseq-nodebook, built on the same @nodebook/dom renderer

summary: Renders nodeBook code fences as interactive CNL knowledge graphs with inferred relations, morph switching, containment view, and Petri-net simulation.
